metadata.tags: Upbeat and energetic pop-rock track characterized by a driving rhythm and bright instrumentation. The song features a prominent electric guitar playing rhythmic power chords and melodic riffs, supported by a punchy drum kit with a steady four-on-the-floor kick drum and crisp snare hits. A melodic bassline provides a solid foundation, locking in with the percussion. The vocals are delivered by a clear, youthful male voice with a moderate range, utilizing a straightforward and catchy melodic structure. The tempo is approximately 128 BPM in the key of G major. Production is clean and polished, with light reverb on the vocals and a balanced mix that emphasizes the interplay between the guitars and the vocal melody. The structure follows a standard verse-chorus-verse format with a brief instrumental bridge.
